svg.text: Use isolated copper pads, 2.54 mm pitch, at least 24 columns x 20 rows. Do NOT use connected stripboard.
LOLIN D1 mini V4 / photographed Wiegand reader | proposed build; not bench-tested
Use insulation all the way to each pad.
Dots mark solder points. Each color/group forms one electrical net. Route insulated wires as convenient.
Strip only 2-3 mm at each wire end. Solder the wire to the existing pad/lead; do not bridge adjacent pads.
The numbers and letters identify the SAME holes as page 3, even though this view is mirrored.
